output_list.criticism: The Integer Overflow in the mintToken function is: the totalSupply variable is used in a mathematical operation without a safeguard, allowing an attacker to set the totalSupply to a very high value, thus exploiting the Integer Overflow in the mint function.

The Wrong Logic in the buy function is: the buy function always uses the setPrices function to set the sellPrice and buyPrice, but the setPrices function is not called, causing the buy function to always use the default price.
